description.value: Private resort campground 35 km east of Revelstoke off the Trans-Canada, set in old-growth Selkirk rainforest between Glacier and Mount Revelstoke National Parks; two natural mineral hot-spring pools are on-site but charged separately from camping, and the season closes in September.

address.value: 7050 Trans-Canada Hwy, Revelstoke, BC V0E 2S0, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active campground and hot springs resort located 35 km east of Revelstoke on the Trans Canada Highway, with 100 camping/RV sites, cabins, and natural hot springs pools. Phone number matches between OSM and website. OSM email (info@canyonhotsprings.com) differs from website email (canyonhotsprings@outlook.com), which is a concern. The FAQ explicitly confirms ice is available for purchase, limited snacks/drinks at the office, reservations via 'Book Now' button, and seasonal operation (spring through September). No mention of hiker/biker sites, showers, laundry, bike tools, or cyclist-specific amenities.
concerns: OSM email (info@canyonhotsprings.com) differs from website email (canyonhotsprings@outlook.com); website value is likely more current
Seasonal operation only: open spring through September
No street address available from OSM or website
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active campground directly on the Trans Canada Highway with amenities useful to touring cyclists, including camping sites, hot springs for recovery, on-site snacks, and ice. A natural stop on the Rogers Pass corridor.

wow_evidence: two natural mineral hot-spring pools are on-site
